Theorem
[existence of dilation-limit singularity models] Source: cao-zhu 1. Theorem 4.3.4\group Cao–Zhu Limiting Singularity Models For any maximal solution to the Ricci flow which satisfies the injectivity radius condition and is of Type I, II(a), (b), or III(a), there exists a sequence of dilations of the solution along (almost) maximum points which converges in the $C_{\rm loc}^{\infty }$ topology to a singularity model of the corresponding type.
